title: Anteriority Temporal Clauses: mire + Perfective Verbs

sections.title: Temporal Subordination with mire
sections.content: The temporal conjunction 'mire' introduces an anteriority clause meaning 'by the time that'. The subordinate clause typically contains a verb with a perfective verbal prefix (preverb: fel-, meg-, el-, ki-) denoting an action that reaches completion: 'Mire felnőtt...' ('By the time he grew up...'), 'Mire a törvényjavaslatot elfogadták...' ('By the time the bill was passed...').

sections.title: Matrix Clause Correlation: már and addigra
sections.content: The matrix clause governed by a 'mire' clause almost universally employs correlating temporal adverbs, predominantly 'már' ('already') or 'addigra' ('by that time'). This structure establishes a sharp contrast between the reference point marked by 'mire' and the prior completion of the main event: 'Mire hazaért, addigra a család már megvacsorázott' ('By the time he arrived home, by that time the family had already had dinner').

sections.title: Correlating mire Clauses with Matrix Adverbs
rows: Mire felébredt, már kisütött a nap.
Mire a segély megérkezett, addigra felépült a ház.
Mire megérkezel, már készen lesz az ebéd.
Mire nyugdíjba ment, megváltozott a társadalom.

items.spanish: Mire a fiatal generáció felnőtt, a munkaerőpiaci viszonyok teljesen átalakultak.
items.english: By the time the young generation grew up, labor market conditions had completely transformed.

items.spanish: Mire a nagyszülők nyugdíjba vonultak, addigra a gyermekeik már önálló egzisztenciát teremtettek.
items.english: By the time the grandparents retired, by then their children had already established an independent livelihood.

items.spanish: Mire a demográfiai intézkedések hatni kezdtek, már jelentősen megnőtt az idős korosztály aránya.
items.english: By the time the demographic measures began to take effect, the proportion of the elderly cohort had already grown significantly.

items.spanish: Mire a reformokat bevezették, addigra a költségvetési hiány már tarthatatlanná vált.
items.english: By the time the reforms were introduced, by then the budget deficit had already become unsustainable.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Always ensure the verb in the 'mire' clause carries the appropriate perfective preverb (meg-, fel-, el-) when signaling that the milestone has been fully reached.
